newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, off early highs.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Tuesday, relinquishing early gains as the yen recovered against the dollar in the afternoon, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.1 yen per kg lower to 1.0 yen firmer. Most-active October was down 1.1 yen at 140.4 yen.

The market started firmer, with bullish sentiment carried over from last Friday, but profit-taking gathered force in reaction to the yen's rebound. "The yen's recovery poured cold water on market sentiment," one trader said. Prices could be sandwiched in a range for some time by bargain-hunting on the downside and selling on any rallies, he added.
